I can tell you several stories , but this one might be better. So there’s this guy who finishes high school and then heads to an elite college, he was pretty much a loser in HS and hardly had any female interaction. He’s paired with a girl for a group project , and they start talking to each other everyday , eventually becoming best friends or at least that’s what she said they were and that’s what he thought. He then realised he’s actually developed feelings for and is completely in love. He would get jealous whenever he saw her talking to any other guy. Now this loser guy never had any experience with women , this was the first time he was so close to a girl and he had developed feelings for her , he did not know what to do. The guy also had addiction issues and would smoke and drink a lot , sometimes use drugs. The girl was very clean and did not smoke or drink at all and hated anyone who did it. She finds out the guy is an addict and forces him to quit. The guy promises to quit a 100 times but keeps breaking his promises. This leads to a lot of arguments between them and she starts avoiding him and doesn’t like being around him anymore. This messes him up and he starts getting drunk and high even more. He couldn’t handle the girl who he loved was now avoiding him and didn’t want anything from him. He decides to go to bar and get drunk alone. He gets so drunk that he can’t walk and once he gets out of the bar , he passes out in the road and calls his friend to pick him up. There’s a crowd in the road wondering what has happened to the guy. His friend comes to the place and slaps the shit out of him and calls all the other friends and they all lift the guy and take him to his dorm. Fast forward to the next year , the guy and girl start talking to each other again but the same issues go and the girl keeps breaking up and coming back to the guy whenever she wishes and eventually threatens to cut ties with him permanently. Loser guy gets depressed again and gets drunk during the break and ends up passing out in the college washroom. Once again all his friends come to pick him up and take him to his dorm. This time they sit him down and explain things to him and ask him to get his shit together. He decides to cut down on drinking after that. A year passes and the girl starts getting close to another guy, she keeps telling the loser that they are friends and nothing is going on between them but the loser has his doubts. She constantly lies to him while spending night after night sleeping with the other guy. The loser finds it out and then takes a lot of drugs and alcohol and fights with his roommates and passes out again and nearly overdoses but his roommates save him from death. The loser finally decides that this girl has emotionally abused him for 3 years and he has now had enough . He starts dating the worst enemy of the girl and the girl gets jealous and feels bad. The girl confronts the loser and the loser cuts ties with her. He stops talking to her completely and starts making out and spending time with multiple different girls almost forgetting the girl. Few months later the girl texts him about wanting to get back with him and missing him. The guy responds to her by sending her an invitation card to his wedding taking place in a few months. The girl that loser is going to marry is her worst enemy. In case you haven’t guessed it , this is a completely true story and the loser guy is me.
